claims.pass_condition: A cache key changes when the exact package, dependency package/path/digest/bytes, executor, verifier, or seed changes and remains stable otherwise.
claims.primary_surface: Canonical key-contract execution with exact fixtures
claims.counterevidence: A bound field changes without changing the key, or equivalent bindings produce different keys.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Sealed entry manifest binds the complete key record and recomputes to the same key.
claims.observed_evidence: The runtime key is the canonical digest of the complete binding; entry readback recomputes and compares both the key digest and canonical binding.

claims.pass_condition: A cold run stores immutable verified entries and a distinct later run reuses the same artifact digests without invoking eligible executors.
claims.primary_surface: Two complete three-package runs using separate run IDs and one external cache root
claims.counterevidence: The second run invokes an executor, changes an artifact digest, or succeeds without a cache receipt.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Separate CLI process cold and warm runs with on-disk ledger inspection
claims.observed_evidence: The cold run invoked three executors and emitted three MISS_STORED receipts; the warm run invoked zero executors and emitted three HIT receipts with identical output digests. Separate CLI processes reproduced the route.

claims.pass_condition: Every hit runs the currently appointed verifier against copied cache bytes and declared dependency inputs before candidate acceptance.
claims.primary_surface: Verifier invocation counters and fresh verification receipts on a zero-executor warm run
claims.counterevidence: A hit reaches VERIFIED with no current verifier call or only stored testimony.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: A same-identity verifier that rejects the first cached candidate forces fresh execution and a second verification.
claims.observed_evidence: Three warm hits caused three current-verifier calls. A deliberate current-verifier rejection produced REJECTED, one fresh executor call, a second current verification, and only then CANDIDATE_READY.

claims.pass_condition: Changed manifest or artifact bytes cannot become a hit; the affected package executes and verifies freshly while unaffected entries remain reusable.
claims.primary_surface: On-disk cached artifact mutation followed by a new run
claims.counterevidence: Tampered bytes are copied into a candidate, reported HIT, or silently replace the entry.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Stable rejection code and exact output digest comparison
claims.observed_evidence: A changed artifact produced CACHE_ARTIFACT_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH, REJECTED, one fresh execution, three verifier calls, and an exact valid candidate; two unaffected packages remained hits.

claims.pass_condition: Two separate processes publishing the same key converge on one complete entry with no partial or temporary residue.
claims.primary_surface: Concurrent child-process publishers into one new cache root
claims.counterevidence: Both overwrite, entry readback fails, artifact bytes are partial, or a .next directory remains.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Post-race manifest and artifact digest readback
claims.observed_evidence: The publishers returned STORED and EXISTS; the entry read back as HIT with exact integrity and no temporary directory remained.

claims.pass_condition: No invalidation occurs without explicit authority; an explicit exact-key request removes only that entry and returns a sealed receipt.
claims.primary_surface: Refused and explicit API calls plus separate CLI process calls
claims.counterevidence: An unrequested call creates or removes state, a different key disappears, or no readback confirms removal.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Filesystem existence checks for selected and unrelated entries
claims.observed_evidence: The unrequested CLI route created no directory and returned NOT_REQUESTED. Explicit invalidation returned REMOVED, selected-entry readback was absent, and unrelated entries remained hits.

claims.pass_condition: A different result for an existing exact key is reported as counterevidence and never overwrites the first complete entry.
claims.primary_surface: Second publication with the same binding and different bytes
claims.counterevidence: The original entry changes or the second result is reported as a valid hit/store.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Original entry digest and byte readback after conflict
claims.observed_evidence: The second publication returned CONFLICT with CACHE_SAME_KEY_DIFFERENT_RESULT and the original entry remained readable.

claims.pass_condition: Representative production workloads show lower wall time and compute use across repeated controlled runs without reducing verification coverage.
claims.primary_surface: Named workload telemetry with cold/warm repetitions and verifier counts
claims.counterevidence: Cache overhead outweighs saved work or verification coverage decreases.
claims.observed_evidence: Executor call elimination is proven, but no representative native production workload or timing telemetry exists yet.

claims.pass_condition: A declared quota and retention policy bound storage, propose reference-aware cleanup, require authority, and verify reclaimed bytes.
claims.primary_surface: Long-running cache inventory plus governed retention receipts
claims.counterevidence: Entries grow without bound or automatic deletion removes reachable evidence.
claims.observed_evidence: Entries persist until exact explicit invalidation; there is no automatic quota, eviction, reachability scan, or garbage collector.
